# Menu Button

Open a command menu from one trigger and restore focus on dismissal.

## Usage

### Action menu

Create or import workspace resources from one compact trigger.

<ComponentExample component="menu-button" scenario="actions" title="Action menu" description="Create or import workspace resources from one compact trigger." :index="0" />

### Nested submenu

Keep secondary export formats inside the Export as command.

<ComponentExample component="menu-button" scenario="nested" title="Nested submenu" description="Keep secondary export formats inside the Export as command." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

## Motion example

Menu Button exposes public `data-state` on its popup content, so entry and exit can be styled on the same element. Keep option highlighting and popup motion as separate visual concerns.

```css
[data-scope='menu-button'][data-part='content'][data-state='open'] {
  animation: menu-button-open 160ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}

[data-scope='menu-button'][data-part='content'][data-state='closed'] {
  animation: menu-button-close 120ms ease-in;
}

@keyframes menu-button-open {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px) scale(.985); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

@keyframes menu-button-close {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-2px) scale(.99); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='menu-button'][data-part='content'] { animation: none !important; }
}
```

[Read the shared motion guidance](/guides/motion)

## Accessibility

The trigger exposes popup and expanded state; the opened content uses menu semantics and returns focus on close.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/) for the host accessibility contract.
